name: Windows TCP SYN Attack Protection Enabled
description: Ensures Windows SynAttackProtect is enabled (1), improving resilience against SYN flood attacks. Required Windows permission: LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect via delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v SynAttackProtect
